Name: Care Bears
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
a custom furniture/alternative textures mod that adds multiple care bears to the game ♡ i was surprised there wasnt already a care bear mod, so i just made one myself

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[b][size=4][img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
[/size][/b]1. download and install custom furniture
2. download this mod
3. unzip mod into stardew's mod folder

[b][size=4][img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/b]♡ includes cheer bear, funshine bear, tenderheart bear, good luck bear, grumpy bear, bedtime bear, share bear, love-a-lot bear and wish bear
♡ sprites made by me
♡ when using the alternative textures version, use the paint bucket (can be bought from Robin) on the large futan bear to change it to whichever care bear you want
